title: UnknownsRegister
description: Schema for the unknowns register. Tracks all unresolved questions, gaps, or ambiguities identified during agent execution that require human clarification, ownership assignment, or escalation before work can proceed safely.

unknown_id.description: Unique identifier for this unknown item.

category.description: Category classifying the nature of the unknown.

description.description: Clear description of what is unknown or unresolved.

severity.description: Severity level indicating the impact of this unknown on proceeding with the work.

impact.description: Description of the impact on the deliverable or process if this unknown remains unresolved.

owner_needed.description: Role or team that needs to resolve or own this unknown.

resolution_action.description: Recommended action to resolve this unknown.

status.description: Current status of this unknown item.

resolved_by.description: Identity of the person or process that resolved this unknown.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this unknown was resolved.
